panels.missing: Keshavrao is drawn from the front with his head turned away from Nagoji. Both of his chained hands are clasped together at his belly. The script needs him seen from behind, with his head turned a few degrees toward the whisper, eyes forward and shoulders rigid. His right hand should hang at his hip, curled around an absent grip. There are also smaller problems: the guard walks ahead of Keshavrao instead of in the gap between him and Nagoji, and Nagoji's wrist cuffs have no chain joining them.
